reviewContext.issueReference: Work Runtime P1-6b; no GitHub issue number supplied
reviewContext.userProblem: The prior P1-6b workflow could not pass its sandbox listener gate after final-source repairs; the listener-capable host aggregate subsequently passed 198/198 on the same nine source/test hashes.
requiredOutcomes: Independently accept current P1-6b results and read-only dry-run only if no material defect remains.
Align directly affected design, plan, and progress evidence; publish the exact reviewed P1-6b files by non-force push on feat/remaining-impl-plans.
Keep P1-6c/d, P1-7a/b, and parent P1 active.
nonGoals: No new coding or host test rerun on unchanged bytes without a material defect or evidence gap.
No director/cancellation redesign, legacy removal, new examples or schema, broad formatting, main merge, or unrelated worktree changes.
constraints: Use immutable user-scope codex-design-and-implement-review-loop in issue-resolution mode; preserve accepted design §17.5 and one accepted active plan.
Use source-matched host 198/198 as positive aggregate evidence; retain sandbox listener run as failed.
Keep scratch under repository-root tmp/ with complete foreground logs and final exits; preserve unrelated staged, tracked and untracked changes; no force push.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Use existing task result model and P1-6a dispatcher; dry-run resolves the same task/workflow/placement but stops before reservation and launch.
Select read-only dependencies before writable loaders; reject nonempty WAL and preview private database copies to avoid stale reads while preserving live SQLite behavior.
Compare original main/WAL/SHM inventory and bytes after copying and before ready/wait output; concurrent changes become errors.
intentionalTradeoffs: One plan owns tightly coupled P1-6b source, tests, and docs; serial owner reconciles shared parent P1 files, with independent read-only reviews and Astra combined-tree acceptance.
Reuse completed host aggregate and safe-suite/strict-lint evidence on identical source hashes; rerun only affected checks after material repair.
supportedEdgeCases: Ready/wait/admitted failure/pre-admission error in text and JSON, with exact reserved IDs only after admission.
Existing, absent, incompatible and corrupt stores; WAL/SHM present or absent; existing, absent and corrupt profiles; row values including work_hosts.
Selected-host and called-workflow placement, pending entry, reservation races, and concurrent writer observation.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: P1-6c/d decisions, interruption and director behavior; P1-7a/b removal and replacement examples; real credential probes.
reviewContext.reviewDecision: Step 3 design accepted at comm-000004; Step 5 single plan accepted at comm-000006 with no findings. Implementation acceptance remains downstream.

plans.sharedPathIntent: One plan owns coupled P1-6b source and tests. Parent P1 Swift and documentation paths overlap later slices, so serial reconciliation must preserve their changes; read-only reviewers do not edit files.
acceptanceCriteria: Nine final Swift source/test hashes match tmp/work-runtime-p1-6b-host-final/evidence.json and final-source Step 6 evidence.
Host aggregate passes 198/198 on final hashes; source-matched safe suites and strict changed-file SwiftLint retain passing evidence; sandbox listener aggregate remains failed.
Independent test-integrity, adversarial and Astra combined-tree review find no unresolved material defect, including SQLite private-copy path selection and read-only behavior.
Exact accepted P1-6b files are committed and non-force pushed while P1-6c/d, P1-7a/b and parent P1 stay active.
